subject.title: fix(tools): surface empty availability group diagnostics via onHiddenDiagnostic callback

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's warn-only preservation of plugin-authored availability metadata as the canonical fix for malformed availability diagnostics?
rationale: The code path now looks mechanically sound, but preserving previously ignored plugin metadata can change upgrade-visible plugin author diagnostics and overlaps with sibling candidate PRs, so the final choice is a maintainer compatibility decision.

options.title: Accept this PR as canonical
options.body: Land this implementation after normal rebase and CI because it keeps the evaluator pure and surfaces authoring warnings without hiding additional tools.

options.title: Choose a narrower sibling
options.body: Supersede this PR only if maintainers prefer a smaller implementation that still wires production plugin diagnostics and preserves the linked issue's expected startup warning.

options.title: Defer plugin diagnostics
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and reject metadata preservation if maintainers do not want existing malformed plugin descriptors to start warning on upgrade.

recommendation.title: Accept this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Land this implementation after normal rebase and CI because it keeps the evaluator pure and surfaces authoring warnings without hiding additional tools.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is centered on plugin descriptor caching and plugin resolver compatibility, where steipete has the clearest recent feature-history signal.
